# Iconic Cleaning
> Exterior cleaning and care services in Keizer, Oregon and the Willamette Valley. Oregon CCB #262418. (541) 405-0972.

## Services
- [Pressure Washing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/pressure-washing/): driveways, walkways, patios, hardscape. $200–$600
- [House Washing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/house-washing/): soft-wash siding cleaning. $350–$900

- [Deck Cleaning & Sealing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/deck-cleaning/): cleaning, brightening, sealing wood decks. $400–$1,100
- [Concrete Sealing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/concrete-sealing/): driveways and patios after cleaning. $0.50–$1.50 per sq ft
- [Fence Cleaning & Staining](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/fence-cleaning/): cleaning and staining cedar and treated fence. $450–$1,400
- [Paver Cleaning & Sanding](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/paver-cleaning/): cleaning, weed removal, polymeric re-sanding. $400–$1,200
- [Solar Panel Cleaning](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/solar-panel-cleaning/): rinse and soft-wash for panel output. $150–$400
- [Graffiti Removal](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/graffiti-removal/): chemical and pressure removal. $200–$800
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/dryer-vent-cleaning/): full vent line clearing. $120–$250
- [Commercial Pressure Washing](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/commercial-washing/): storefronts, sidewalks, lots, drive-thrus. Quoted by square footage
- [Rust & Stain Removal](https://bannisterderik-tech.github.io/db-demos/iconic-cleaning-llc/services/rust-stain-removal/): rust, oil, and organic staining. $200–$600
